[attribute-xmlns-xi]
=== `@xmlns:xi` XInclude Namespace Declaration

This is not an attribute, but the namespace pseudo-attribute. The value provides a namespace prefix and URI to use for the XInclude elements. All namespace prefixes must be associated with a URL, and the prefix “`xi`” has been set to the URL for the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) XInclude Recommendation.

#### FIXED (not settable) on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-adoption,`<adoption>`>>, <<element-app,`<app>`>>, <<element-app-group,`<app-group>`>>, <<element-standard,`<standard>`>>, <<element-xi-fallback,`<xi:fallback>`>>, <<element-xi-include,`<xi:include>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude| The prefix “`xi`” has been set to the URL for the W3C XInclude Recommendation.
| Restriction| This attribute has a fixed value which may not be changed in the XML document.
|===
